interventions.representation: Balanced KL to learned conditional Gaussian auxiliary head; not KL to the implicit iMF prior
interventions.imagination: Only iMF generates imagined stochastic states; fixed four-step sampling
interventions.reward: Unchanged proper upstream two-hot reward loss; reward_grad=true; repval_grad=false protects model features from replay-value regression
interventions.learning: All modules including actor learn from first replay-ready update; no frozen blocks, horizon 15, full time gaps, constant flow loss scale one
interventions.replay: Unchanged uniform online replay, no reward oversampling, no demonstrations or pretraining

diagnostics.positive_selection: whole real row with eligible five-step positive endpoint; correlated diagnostic only

limitations: Single seed bundled exploratory repair, not causal isolation or confirmation
Auxiliary Gaussian may mismatch a multimodal implicit prior
Continuous posterior and velocity architecture remain different from DreamerV3
Reward coverage is measured, not guaranteed by this intervention
